label: Generic canonical records before approved identity adjudication
counting_rule: DOI-first normalized identity key, with normalized-title fallback; related-version links are preserved rather than collapsed.
qualifications: Intermediate reconciliation count; not a final diagram endpoint.

label: Approved exact-identity adjudications
counting_rule: Count approved adjudication proposals applied after generic canonicalization.
qualifications: These proposals merge canonical groups; they are not additional source occurrences or exclusions.

label: Canonical records available for screening
counting_rule: Count final registered canonical records after approved identity adjudication.

label: Occurrence surplus consolidated
counting_rule: Difference between preserved source occurrences and final canonical records.
qualifications: Not a count of scientifically excluded studies; includes cross-source duplicate occurrences consolidated under the recorded identity rule.

label: Protected benchmark/calibration records
counting_rule: Records frozen out of operational machine screening for benchmark evaluation/calibration.

label: Protected primary/evaluation pilot records
counting_rule: Frozen evaluation sample; disposition remains separate from operational machine-screening outcomes.

label: Protected calibration records
counting_rule: Frozen calibration sample; disposition remains separate from operational machine-screening outcomes.

label: Valid effective title/abstract screenings
counting_rule: Count each canonical record once at its latest valid effective screening outcome; superseded INCLUDE nominations are replaced by precision outcomes.

label: Technical failures after terminal continuation
counting_rule: Count unique remaining-queue records with no valid screening result after terminal continuation.
qualifications: Technical failure is not scientific exclusion.

label: Ambiguous requests not resubmitted
counting_rule: Count unresolved request identities excluded from resubmission because no retrievable provider response ID was saved.
qualifications: Ambiguity is not scientific exclusion.

label: Genuinely unprocessed records
counting_rule: Terminal still_unprocessed count after safe retries and continuation.
qualifications: Zero is used because the terminal artifact explicitly reports complete queue processing, not because missing states were assumed absent.

label: Effective INCLUDE / ADVANCE outcomes
counting_rule: Use precision outcomes for the 890 re-screened nominations, then add terminal remaining-queue ADVANCE outcomes.
qualifications: Model-nominated candidates; not final included studies.

label: Effective DEFER outcomes
counting_rule: Retain unre-screened prior DEFER records; replace prior INCLUDE outcomes with precision DEFER where applicable; add remaining-queue DEFER.
equation: 172 initial DEFER + 10304 overnight DEFER + 201 precision DEFER + 72581 remaining DEFER = 83258
qualifications: DEFER is not scientific exclusion.

label: Effective EXCLUDED outcomes
counting_rule: Retain unre-screened prior EXCLUDED records; replace prior INCLUDE outcomes with precision EXCLUDED where applicable; add remaining-queue EXCLUDED.
equation: 63 initial EXCLUDED + 3248 overnight EXCLUDED + 43 precision EXCLUDED + 44693 remaining EXCLUDED = 48047

label: Known H2H3 background designations
counting_rule: Add disjoint precision and remaining-queue background subsets; do not add them to exclusions.
qualifications: Subset of A13, not an additional outcome. The terminal background CSV named in the manifest is not present locally; the count is bound to terminal JSON reports.

label: Final categorized machine-coded candidate records
counting_rule: Parse logical CSV records and require one unique canonical_id per row.
qualifications: Coding completion is descriptive taxonomy coding, not another eligibility decision and not literature prevalence.

label: Selected report-identity rows across all assessment waves
counting_rule: Count every persisted report/candidate identity row once; related reports are retained as rows.
qualifications: Not equal to unique systems; several rows can concern one system.

label: Distinct systems considered
counting_rule: Use persisted system grouping; related report versions do not create new systems when linked.
qualifications: Two same-title pairs remain distinct persisted system identities because no authoritative grouping was established; title equality alone was not used to merge them.

label: Accessible full-report rows
counting_rule: Count report rows marked AVAILABLE or ACCESSIBLE; exclude abstract-only and unavailable rows.
qualifications: 135 report rows map to 132 completed system assessments because three accessible related-report rows do not create new system assessments.

label: Abstract-only selected report rows
counting_rule: Count report rows explicitly marked ABSTRACT_ONLY_NOT_FULL_REPORT.
qualifications: Not an accessible full report and not a completed system assessment.

label: Unavailable selected report rows
counting_rule: Count report rows marked INACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_AFTER_BOUNDED_ATTEMPT.
qualifications: An unavailable report is an access state, not scientific rejection; attempt events are not added to this count.

label: Completed system-level eligibility assessments
counting_rule: Count systems with full-report ELIGIBLE, UNRESOLVED, or EXCLUDED_CONTEXTUAL outcomes; exclude inaccessible systems.

label: Systems without a completed full-report assessment
counting_rule: Count system groups with effective INACCESSIBLE status, including the abstract-only system.
qualifications: Not scientific exclusion and not synonymous with a single failed access attempt.

label: Eligible systems
counting_rule: Count completed system assessments with effective ELIGIBLE status.

label: Scientifically unresolved systems
counting_rule: Count completed system assessments with effective UNRESOLVED status.
qualifications: StarmapVis remains here. MinOmics is system-eligible, but its Immersive × Large Display target placement remains unresolved and uncounted.

label: Excluded or contextual systems
counting_rule: Count completed system assessments with effective EXCLUDED_CONTEXTUAL status.

label: Eligible systems with at least one supported map placement
counting_rule: Count each eligible system once if it has at least one SUPPORTED assistance–modality placement.
qualifications: Automated assessment; pending author approval.

label: Eligible systems without a supported map placement
counting_rule: Set difference between eligible systems and systems represented by SUPPORTED placement rows.
qualifications: CAVEman; LiverPlan; Semantic molecular-analysis pipeline; YASARA Model VR

label: Supported system–cell placements
counting_rule: Count each eligible system once per Assistance × Modality cell with report-level SUPPORTED evidence.
qualifications: Multilabel and non-additive across cells; automated assessment pending author approval.

label: Selected report rows with an exact 9,505-pool canonical-ID link
counting_rule: Intersect canonical IDs in the cumulative report crosswalk with the terminal 9,505-ID set.
qualifications: Eight unmatched rows entered through coauthor or bounded map-expansion routes; exact linkage does not prove selection originated from the candidate export.

label: Considered systems with at least one exact 9,505-pool canonical-ID link
counting_rule: Group exact canonical-ID-linked report rows by persisted system identity.
qualifications: Do not infer a direct subset relationship for the eight systems without an exact terminal-candidate match.
